summary: Independently verified Force Password Reset feature end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_force_password_reset.py covering login must_change_password flag, /auth/me flag, /auth/change-password (auth required, wrong current => 400, new<8 chars => 400, new==current => 400, success clears flag), old temp password rejected after change, and seed users (super/admin/marketer) return must_change_password=false. Frontend E2E via Playwright: super not gated -> reaches /clients; bulk-invite-button opens dialog; invited user login redirects to /change-password; direct nav to /clients and /dashboard both bounce back to /change-password; validations block wrong current (backend 400 toast), new<8 chars (client), mismatch (client); successful change navigates to /clients; re-login with new password not gated; old temp password fails login; admin/super/marketer seed users skip /change-password.
critical_code_review_comments: ChangePassword.js client-side validations only show sonner toasts and do not render inline error text next to inputs; consider adding inline field errors for accessibility.
Backend /api/auth/change-password uses 400 for wrong current password; typically 401 is more standard for credential-based rejection. Non-blocking.

Frontend ProtectedRoute performs an /auth/me network call on every mount which duplicates request when navigating between protected routes; consider caching the profile briefly to avoid double GETs (seen in traces).

ChangePassword success path only updates localStorage.user with must_change_password:false — relies on subsequent /auth/me from ProtectedRoute for source of truth (works, but slightly race-prone if navigate happens before setItem persists in some browsers).
seed_data_creation: Created transient invited users test_fpr_* and test_ui_fpr_*; all deleted post-test. Verified only the 4 seed users remain (super, admin, manager, marketer).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Force Password Reset feature is fully working. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_force_password_reset.py (12 tests, ~6s). Bulk invite POST /api/users/bulk-invite response shape: {role, summary{...}, results:[{email,status,temp_password,reason}]} — filter results by status=='invited' to pick up temp_password.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial pytest fixture failure was due to test parsing bulk-invite response with legacy key 'invited' rather than 'results'; fixed in test file. Initial Playwright script had a batched-submissions timing issue where four consecutive submits ran too quickly — reworked isolated success test using page.wait_for_url and confirmed navigation to /clients works reliably.
